lesson_quiz.question: Ai la nguoi cung cac cong su thiet ke ra Python va tich hop bo ba lenh dieu khien break, continue, va pass?
lesson_quiz.explanation: Theo bai doc, Guido van Rossum cung doi ngu thiet ke Python da tich hop bo ba lenh dieu khien nay de giai quyet cac thach thuc ve dieu huong dong chay he thong.

lesson_quiz.question: De bo qua mot ban ghi bi loi va tiep tuc thuc hien vong lap voi ban ghi tiep theo ma khong dung chuong trinh, ta nen su dung lenh nao?
lesson_quiz.explanation: Bai doc chi ra rang de bo qua ban ghi loi va chuyen ngay sang ban ghi ke tiep ma khong lam gian doan tien trinh, ta dung co che dieu khien bieu thi qua tu khoa continue.

lesson_quiz.question: Neu mot he thong tim thay tai khoan VIP can quet trong database o vi tri thu muoi tren mot trieu, hanh dong phu hop nhat tu he thong la gi?
options: Quet tiep 999.990 khach hang con lai
Dung ngay vong lap nho lenh break de tiet kiem CPU
Su dung lenh pass de khoi dong lai he thong
Xoa toan bo luong giao dich dang chay
lesson_quiz.explanation: Bai doc cho thay viec tiep tuc quet cac khach hang con lai sau khi da tim thay muc tieu la vo nghia, can phai dung ngay vong lap (su dung break) de tranh lam treo ung dung.

lesson_quiz.question: Lenh nao trong bo ba cho phep phac thao khoi lenh rong ma khong bi loi cu phap?
lesson_quiz.explanation: Bai doc neu ro rang lam lap trinh vien can phac thao cac khung cau truc rong (prototyping) maf khong muon co loi cu phap thi su dung pass.

practical_lab.title: Toi uu hoa he thong kiem toan giao dich doanh nghiep
objectives: Ap dung cau truc break de thoat vong lap ngay khi dat muc tieu
Su dung continue de bo qua ban ghi giao dich bi loi du lieu
Su dung pass de phan dinh cac ham chuc nang bo tro sap phat trien

description.inputs: Dự án/môi trường phát triển python/core hiện tại và tài nguyên khóa học.
steps: Buoc 1: Dinh nghia mot danh sach gia dinh chua cac giao dich dang tu dien voi cac truong: id (so nguyen), status (chuoi: 'VALID', 'ERROR', 'VIP_TARGET'), va amount (so thuc).
Buoc 2: Su dung vong lap for de duyet tung giao dich. Neu thoi diem quet gap phai status la 'ERROR', dung continue de bo qua ma khong thuc hien cac kiem tra phia sau.
Buoc 3: Neu phat hien status la 'VIP_TARGET', in ra thong bao va go lenh break de dung toan bo vong lap, ngan chuong trinh quet cac phan tu phia sau.
Buoc 4: Khai bao mot ham trong co ten audit_security_log bang pass nham muc dich chuan bi cho cac tinh nang kiem tra phu phat trien sau.

checklist: Khong in ra thong bao loi cua cac giao dich co trang thai ERROR
Vong lap phai dung ngay lap tuc va khong in ra hay xu ly cac phan tu dung sau VIP_TARGET
Ham audit_security_log duoc khoi tao thanh cong voi pass ma khong gay ra bat ky loi logic hay cu phap nao
